text: Absolutely, I recommend that our school adopts the later start time! The full crossing-guard coverage, as confirmed for the shifted schedule, ensures student safety at all hours. Moreover, becoming the first district statewide to implement this innovative change could set an excellent example for educational institutions across the state. Additionally, consolidating the bus route reduces costs significantly, saving forty thousand annually. Lastly, the pilot school's improvement in attendance has been evident every term since the switch, underscoring its positive impact on students' academic performance and overall well-being. This pilot program not only benefits students but also showcases our commitment to making education accessible and safe for all.
